column1: # /Graph Reset {X | A-F | Ranges | Options} — clear individual
# slots without nuking the whole graph.
# Slice F (reset leaves) of GRAPH_PLAN.md. The Reset Graph leaf
# already worked (clears everything to default). This slice promotes
# the per-slot leaves from NotImplemented stubs to real actions:
#   Ranges — clear def.x and all of def.data, keep type/features/options
#   Options — restore def.options to default, keep ranges and type
# Seed A1..A4 = 1, 2, 3, 4 so /GA has cells to point at.
# /GTB then /GA over A1..A4 then /GX over A1..A4 (cheap dummy).
# Set a Title and a Legend so we can confirm Reset Options restores
# Re-bind A and X so we can test Ranges / Options below.
# /GRR — Reset Ranges. Clears X and A..F, leaves type/options
# /GRO — Reset Options. Restores options (titles, legends, …) to
# default; keeps the type and (already-empty) ranges.
